title: Open Logic Project: Hindi cumulative working edition through HI-OLP-0011
description: Hindi (hi-Deva-IN) cumulative machine-assisted translation of eleven accepted Open Logic Project sections, with a 17-page compiled and visually checked reader, editable TeX, exact frozen source authority, terminology and complete relevant provenance/QA evidence. This release does not claim whole-work completion, human review, peer review, or PDF/UA certification.
